text:
Leah: Quick sync — Acme asked to push their current agreement by 6 months and move to annual upfront billing. Procurement says they need PO + wiring instructions and an updated SOW. Can we get this signed this week?

Omar: Do we have flexibility on price? They flagged budget constraints. If we roll 6 months on top, they want a small concession.

Jules: @Omar we can do a one‑time 4% credit on the remaining term, finance ok with that if PO is received before wire cutoff (Tue EOD). Need billing contact and exact total.

Kelsey: I can prep an SOW addendum, keep core MSA unchanged. Any scope changes we need to call out? Also confirm whether DPA needs update for new region.

Leah: No scope changes — just term + billing. They still want the same enablement: two onboarding sessions, product walk for 10 people. Enablement week prefers Apr 12.

Omar: I'll confirm seat counts and usage baseline. If they plan to ramp, mention overage pricing.

Jules: For numbers — rough calc with 4% credit: 
```
List price (annualized): $128,400
4% credit applied: -$5,136
Total due at signing: $123,264
```
Need PO matching that total or callout for tax.

Leah: Noted. I'll ask procurement to send PO to finance@redwood.com and cc me.

Kelsey: Sending SOW addendum draft now. Will remove standard 30‑day review and mark as expedited. @DocuSign Bot can you queue once I upload? :email:

DocuSign Bot: Contract package "Acme RDW extension" uploaded by Kelsey — Envelope created, recipients: acme@acme.com (Signer), omar@redwood.com (Approve), leah@redwood.com (CC). Status: Awaiting signatures.

Omar: I told Acme to expect the DocuSign link. Asked them to attach PO in reply.

Leah: Procurement replied — they can send PO but need our wiring instructions first. @Jules any preferred template? :eyes:

Jules: Use this template for wire reference: 
```
Bank: Redwood Clearing
Acct name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account: 400123987
Routing: 011000015
Ref: ACME-RDW-2026
```
(placeholder values — finance will provide final day-of values when processing).

Leah: Great. I'll pass that to them and ask for the PO by Mon EOD. If PO arrives and DocuSign completes, we can lock price with the 4% credit and schedule enablement for Apr 12.

Omar: Heads up — Acme asked whether we can shorten the invoice terms to Net 15 for this one-off. Finance flagged that as higher risk. @Jules can we do Net 30 but prioritize processing? :thinking:

Jules: We can't move to Net 15 on short notice. We'll keep Net 30 but will expedite the invoice once PO & wire are confirmed.

Kelsey: Received a tiny change request from Acme legal (clause about subcontractors). I'll accept as minor, patch SOW, and re-upload. No rollout blockers.

Leah: Sounds good. Action items: Omar — confirm seats + request PO; Jules — provide final wire details when payment day arrives; Kelsey — re-upload patched SOW and trigger DocuSign; Leah — capture enablement dates and confirm with customer.

Omar: On it. Will update thread when PO lands. :thumbsup:

DocuSign Bot: Envelope "Acme RDW extension" updated — Kelsey added document v2. Status: Awaiting signatures.

Leah: Thanks everyone — ping me if anything changes. I'll record feedback from the customer about pricing sensitivity for next renewal planning.
